title: Classic Greek-Style Roasted Lamb
description: A traditional Greek recipe featuring a slow-roasted lamb shoulder, perfect for special occasions. This dish is full of flavor and aroma, making it a must-try for lamb lovers.
instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
If using red wine and beef broth, pour them into the roasting pan after the first 30 minutes of roasting.
Continue roasting the lamb for another 30-40 minutes, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with your favorite side dishes, such as roasted potatoes, steamed vegetables, or a salad.
Strain the juices from the roasting pan and serve them with the lamb, if desired.
